title: BACK↔DEVOPS-001: Service Deployment + Container Infrastructure
description: DevOps provides service deployment, container infrastructure, CI/CD, IaC, and observability for backend services; Backend supplies deployment requirements, container specifications, scaling/resource needs, and runtime configuration. Grounded in DEVOPS_PLATFORM_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.2 (Backend/Cloud Engineer).

burst_target_rps.description: Burst capability; reference SCALE-4 = 2,000 req/s burst.

runtime_config.description: Non-secret runtime configuration (secrets are handled via DEVOPS↔SEC-001, never inline here).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine service deployment (agent-autonomous). Orchestration-platform or topology changes are platform decisions → Tier-1 ADR.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (deployment alignment at planning; service-deployment integration during development); scaling and incident reviews
confirm_conditions: container_spec uses an immutable image_tag/digest (no floating 'latest')
health_check liveness and readiness paths defined
no secrets present in runtime_config (handled via DEVOPS↔SEC-001)
reject_conditions: missing health checks for a production service
counter_conditions: burst_target_rps exceeds the SCALE-4 ceiling — request capacity/load-test validation
scaling metric ambiguous for the workload — request policy clarification
